messages.subject: Project Umbra - Licence Agreement v2 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our mark-up attached (v2). Headlines for the Licensee: upfront down to £1.0m and royalty to 6.5%; warranty period up to 24 months; liability cap up to the greater of £5m / 200% with a £7.5m IP indemnity cap; term out to seven years; exclusivity 'even as to the Licensor'. Let's get on a call.

Nadia

messages.subject: FW: Project Umbra - Licence Agreement v2 (their mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Henry, Sofia - Pemberton Rowe's mark-up is in. They've pushed the economics down (£1.0m / 6.5%) and the liability caps up. My view: land ~£1.25m / 7.5%, cap at greater of £3m / 150% and £5m IP indemnity, keep the five-year term. Thoughts before I respond?

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
